name: Gernsheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Gernsheim (a white six-spoked wheel on red).
history: Permission to bear a flag was granted to the city by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 12 March 1953; the flag shows the arms on the white middle stripe of a red-white-red cloth.

features.role: Gernsheim arms — white wheel on red
